descriptionMarkdown:
Ratling Trick Feature
Long-Las Sniper
When you use Killshot, the attack 
ignores light and heavy cover and 
ignores resistance from non-
powered armour.
Ratling Trick Feature
Underhive Rat
Once per short rest, when an 
attack misses you while you are in 
cover, you may Hide as a reaction.
Spotter
Your marked target grants +1d4 to 
the next two allied attacks instead 
of one.
Black-Market Gremlin
When you spend downtime in a 
settlement, reduce the cost or 
difficulty of acquiring illegal 
ammunition or forged papers.
